description: List the attractions (or shows / restaurants) at a Six Flags park — the full directory of what’s there, with map coordinates. Static metadata, not live status; use sixflags_get_wait_times for current waits. Defaults to your home park (Carowinds).

park.description: Park name, slug, or id. Defaults to your home park (Carowinds).

type.description: Which kind of entity to list (default ATTRACTION)

name: sixflags_list_attractions
